classifier.definition: For each trace aggregate, scan stack frames from leaf toward root. Select the first resolved function whose name starts with litchi_; strip only a terminal Rust ::h plus 16 hex digits. A trace with no such frame is <other> when all frame names resolve, or <unknown> when any frame name is unresolved. Each trace is assigned exactly one category.
classifier.non_litchi_frames: allocator, RawVec, serde, libc, and other frames are skipped until the nearest resolved litchi_ frame; they are not independently summed
classifier.scope: whole-process heaptrack requested allocation bytes before frees; this is a source-symbol attribution, not a phase attribution or speedup/adoption claim
